# Alcovia: Product, Systems & Analytics Lead assignment

Working proof for the strategy document: two live dashboards, one shared data model, tested SQL, three n8n workflows, a sample PRD and the team's delivery process.

**All data in this repository is synthetic.** It was generated by `scripts/generate_data.py`. No real student, parent or payment data is used.

## Live dashboards

| Dashboard | What it shows | Link |
|---|---|---|
| GTM tracker | Revenue vs target, trial vs full programme, workshops, cash, unpaid invoices, renewals, lead funnel, campaign decisions, ad and landing-page health. Period selector updates everything. | https://taya12hu.github.io/alcovia-assignment/dist/gtm-tracker.html |
| Student progress | Cohort overview with syllabus pace, one-student view with chapter readiness, and programme KPIs (quantity, quality, performance) | https://taya12hu.github.io/alcovia-assignment/dist/student-progress.html |

Both are also in `dist/` as single HTML files that open in any browser, with no server needed.

## What's inside

| Folder | Contents |
|---|---|
| `schema/schema.sql` | One schema for GTM and student data, with unique keys that stop duplicates |
| `data/` | `alcovia_demo.db` (SQLite, ready to query) and `seed.sql` (the same data as INSERTs) |
| `sql/gtm_kpis.sql` | Revenue, unpaid invoices, renewals, funnel, CPQL, campaign decisions, ad ranking, monthly trend |
| `sql/student_kpis.sql` | Chapter stage and syllabus pace, daily habits, programme KPIs, tutor escalations |
| `dashboards/` | Dashboard source: `metrics.js` holds every formula, `index.html` the page |
| `n8n/` | Three workflow exports: Razorpay payments, Meta Ads daily sync, daily advisor alerts |
| `prds/PRD-01-focus-to-realm.md` | First app-adoption experiment, with event tracking plan and decision rules |
| `docs/delivery_framework.md` | 6 stages, 3 gates, ownership, checklists, weekly rhythm |
| `docs/kpi_dictionary.md` | Every metric: formula, source, refresh, owner; campaign decision rules |
| `docs/architecture.md` | How ClickUp, Razorpay, Meta, the app and n8n connect, and what keeps it reliable |
| `tests/` | Checks that dashboard numbers equal SQL numbers |

## Run it

Needs Python 3 and Node 18+.

```bash
python3 scripts/generate_data.py          # rebuild the synthetic data
python3 scripts/run_sql.py sql/gtm_kpis.sql
python3 scripts/run_sql.py sql/student_kpis.sql
python3 scripts/export_sql_results.py && node tests/test_metrics_match_sql.js   # 180/180 checks
node tests/test_student_match_sql.js                                            # 387/387 checks
python3 scripts/build_dashboards.py       # writes dist/*.html
```

With the sqlite3 command-line tool installed, `sqlite3 data/alcovia_demo.db < sql/gtm_kpis.sql` also works.

To load into Postgres:
1. Run `schema/schema.sql`, then `data/seed.sql`.
2. In the SQL files, replace `julianday()` date math with `date - date`.

## n8n workflows

Import each JSON file in n8n (Workflows → Import from file), then connect your own credentials. Secrets are read from environment variables:

| Variable | Used by |
|---|---|
| `RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | 01: verifies that payments really come from Razorpay |
| `META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID` | 02: which ad account to pull |

**Status:** these are valid n8n exports built for this assignment. They have **not** been run against live Razorpay, Meta or ClickUp accounts. Credentials are placeholders.

## Built vs proposed

| Built and tested here | Proposed, not built |
|---|---|
| Schema, synthetic data, SQL | Live syncs from ClickUp, Razorpay, Meta (workflows exist, not connected) |
| Both dashboards, with numbers matching SQL | App event tracking (specified in PRD-01) |
| Campaign decision rules | Wearable integrations beyond the sample data |
| Chapter readiness model and advisor flags | Parent-facing view, role-based access |

## Known limits of the demo

- One sample syllabus (CBSE Class 10, 4 subjects) is used for every student.
- App activity covers only the last 60 days (19 Aug to 17 Oct 2026).
- Landing-page bounce and load time are simulated. In production they come from website analytics.
